_comment: Maps a scanner finding's (source, rule_id) to candidate controls in frameworks/*.json. mapping-agent uses this as a deterministic first pass -- it looks up candidates here, pulls their text from S3, and only asks the LLM to pick/cite/explain among those candidates rather than freely guessing a control_id. Entries are grounded in rule_ids actually observed from lambda/terraform-scanner/fixtures/vulnerable-sample; extend as new rule_ids show up in real scans rather than guessing ahead of evidence. A rule with no confident mapping (e.g. pure hygiene checks like missing descriptions) is deliberately left out rather than force-mapped.
